title: Saptha Kanya
description: Mountain range in Maskeliya, Sri Lanka
extract: Saptha Kanya is a mountain range in Maskeliya, Sri Lanka. It is a ridge of seven peaks near the Norton Estate bordering the Sabaragamuwa Province and Central Province. It is located in the boarder of the Peak Wilderness Sanctuary which is a UNESCO world heritage site.The tallest peak is 1,569 m from the sea level.This mountain range is the main habitat range of the Peak Wilderness Sanctuary elephant herd which is the last remaining elephant population in the wet zone and montane region.
